title: BIS Product Certification - Online Information & Digital Portals
portal_overview: Official digital access point for Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Product Certification (Domestic Manufacturer Scheme), Hallmarking System Reports, Conformity Assessment, and Licencing Information.

schemes.name: Product Certification Scheme (Domestic Manufacturer)
schemes.description: Unified digital interface for domestic Indian manufacturers to apply for Scheme I (ISI Mark) licences, submit Form-V, track application audits, submit surveillance returns, and apply for model/brand inclusions.
key_functions: Online submission of Form-V for new Grant of Licence (GoL)
Simplified Procedure fast-track application with NABL test reports
Normal Procedure application with factory audit scheduling
Inclusion of new varieties, sizes, or brand names to existing CM/L
Payment of application fees, inspection charges, and minimum marking fees (MMF)
50% MSME/Startup fee concession verification via Udyam Registration

schemes.name: Hallmarking Scheme & Online Licence Reports
schemes.description: Public reporting and search portal for checking hallmarked jewellers, active AHC centres, certified gold refineries, and verifying 6-digit HUID authenticity.
key_functions: Search licensed jewellers by State, District, and PIN Code
Search recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centres (AHCs)
View status of cancelled, expired, or suspended hallmarking licences
Verify 6-digit alphanumeric HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification) numbers
Access licensed gold refineries and mints under IS 1417 / IS 1418

associated_online_services.description: One-stop portal to search Indian Standards by IS Number or product keyword, download standard PDFs, Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT), Gazette QCOs, and product manuals.
Exhaustive directory of all 650+ industrial and consumer goods under mandatory Quality Control Orders (QCOs) issued by Central Ministries.
List of products eligible for expedited Grant of Licence within 30 days based on prior testing at NABL accredited labs before factory audit.
Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) for searching testing capabilities across BIS Central, Regional, and NABL accredited partner labs.
Official schedule of application fees (₹1,000), inspection charges (₹7,000/day), testing costs, and Minimum Marking Fees (MMF) with 50% MSME discounts.
Self-declaration of conformity portal for IT, electronics, LED, and solar PV products under MeitY and MNRE mandates.
Scheme X certification enabling overseas manufacturers to obtain ISI mark licences for export to India.
Mobile application for citizens to verify ISI Mark licences (CM/L), CRS registration R-numbers, Hallmarking HUID, and lodge quality complaints directly.

application_workflow_summary.step_1: Standard Identification: Check relevant IS Number and SIT on Know Your Standard (KYS).
application_workflow_summary.step_2: In-House Lab Setup: Install mandatory test equipment as specified in the Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT).
application_workflow_summary.step_3: Online Application: Register and submit Form-V on Manakonline (e-BIS) with manufacturing and testing machinery details.
application_workflow_summary.step_4: Procedure Selection: Choose Normal Procedure (audit first) or Simplified Procedure (NABL lab test report submitted upfront).
application_workflow_summary.step_5: Factory Verification Audit: BIS inspecting officers verify manufacturing facilities, quality controls, and draw independent counter-samples.
application_workflow_summary.step_6: Independent Lab Testing: Samples undergo complete parameter testing at BIS or NABL empanelled laboratories.
application_workflow_summary.step_7: Grant of Licence (GoL): BIS issues official CM/L number permitting the manufacturer to apply the standard ISI Mark on products.
